PROJECT.TITLE: Environmental DNA (eDNA)
PROJECT.DESCRIPTION: OceanOmics is an initiative enabled by Minderoo Foundation (Perth, Australia) and delivered in collaboration with the University of Western Australia (Perth, Australia) Oceans Institute via the Minderoo OceanOmics Centre at UWA. These datasets contain environmental DNA data generated by Minderoo OceanOmics Centre at UWA. OceanOmics Centre uses genomics-based research to characterise marine biodiversity and marine ecosystems. By integrating advanced genomics infrastructure, specialist expertise, and collaborative partnerships, we generate large-scale environmental DNA (eDNA) datasets that support biodiversity discovery, ecological understanding, conservation management, and the development of innovative biomonitoring solutions. We gratefully acknowledge the growing number of community partners, collaborators and organisations whose expertise, innovation and ongoing support contribute to OceanOmics activities, including sample collection, data generation and interpretation, analytical development and biodiversity discovery. OceanOmics Centre is committed to open science and to supporting equitable access to biodiversity data and associated benefits. All users of OceanOmics Centre data are expected to demonstrate professional courtesy and scientific integrity. These resources are intended to support scientific research, conservation and environmental management decision-making, and wider public understanding of marine biodiversity. All data will be released under a licence no more restrictive than Creative Commons Attribution-Non Commercial 4.0 (CC BY NC 4.0). Users accessing data via the public domain should cite the source of OceanOmics Centre data and acknowledge sample providers where applicable. We request the following standard acknowledgment statement to facilitate our impact measurement tracking: We acknowledge funding and support of Minderoo Foundation and Minderoo OceanOmics Centre at UWA in this work and its mission to protect and restore natural ecosystems for future generations. Please see our Data Use & Sharing Policy here: https://minderoo-oceanomics.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/OceanOmics_centre_data_use_and_sharing_policy/OceanOmicsCentre_Data_Use_Sharing_Policy_v1.0.0.pdf
